title: Unified Artifact Naming and Deduplication
description: Unify, finalize and cleanly implement all artifacts. Artifact names must be clear nouns, not verbs derived from their plugin names (e.g. `present` -> `presentation`, `draw` -> `drawing`, `curate` -> `curation`). Additionally, deduplicate: every semio-scoped artifact must be defined exactly once, canonically under ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio/🗿️artifacts/🧿️semio/🏅️standards/🔖️v1/🪆️subsets/.
summary:
Renamed 9 plugin artifacts from verbs/adjectives to clear nouns and fixed artifact-naming hygiene repo-wide.

RENAMES: animate 🎬️present→🎬️presentation; draw 🖍️draw→🖍️drawing; sourcing 🗂️curate→🗂️curation; trinity ♻️rewrite→♻️rewriting; remodel 📸️remodel→📸️remodeling; mathematical ➗️mathematical→➗️equation; procedural 🌀️procedural2d→🌀️generation2d and 🧊️procedural3d→🧊️generation3d; imperative 📜️imperative→📜️procedure. Each covered the directory, the hand-written #[path] wiring chain, Rust modules/types/consts, ArtifactKindSpec id/name/source_format/schema/component_kind, TypeScript barrels, test dirs, and serialized fixtures (JSON, .pack.semio, .dsl.semio, .feature, .graphql, .proto).

DEDUPLICATION: investigated, nothing to remove. Every s.stdio.semio.<subset> schema id is already declared exactly once under 🗄️stdio/🗿️artifacts/🧿️semio/🏅️standards/🔖️v1/🪆️subsets/. Other plugins compose those subsets via #[child(kind = "s.stdio.semio.<subset>")] rather than redefining them.

HYGIENE: stripped emoji from machine ids (data.🔋️model→data.model, data.🏛️program→data.program, text.♻️rewrite→text.rewriting; swept all 92 artifact roots, no others); restored the missing U+FE0F variation selector in directory names against the taxonomy SSOT (◻2d→◻️2d in fem/puzzle/block, 📄txt→📄️txt, 📰xml→📰️xml in stdio, ~700 references plus 13 stragglers in 📜️script.ts, package.json, 🔒️policy-allowlist.json and two 📋️project.json workspace paths); updated 🔣️taxonomy.json centrally; corrected doc-comment drift in 🧿️semio/🦀️.rs (claimed 13 schema-owning subsets and "14 domain + text + base"; actual is 18 domain + ✳️base = 19); fixed 🧹️normalization/🟦️.ts:1323 which hardcoded the pre-rename literal "🖍️draw" and crashed parseTaxonomy.

VERIFICATION: taxonomy registry vs disk is an exact set match (87=87, zero drift); 17,712 of 17,713 #[path] attributes resolve repo-wide (the one failure is in 🌊️flow, untouched here); zero rename-corruption tokens; zero errors naming a renamed token as missing; stdio and animate both cargo-checked clean on wasm32-wasip2.

NOT OURS: a full check of the 14 touched crates reports 7,574 errors, none attributable to this ticket. Dominant families are E0308/E0053 "method empty/from_snapshot/from_text has an incompatible type for trait" from a concurrent async-signature migration (architect alone shows 2,456 errors although its schema file is unmodified here and still declares `async fn empty()`), and a "could not find `mutation`" family proven pre-existing: at commit a807c0706c the file already read `use crate::artifacts::present::mutations::create_tile::mutation::CreateTile`. Rename breakage would surface as E0432/E0433, which total only 306.

OPEN DECISION (deliberately not changed): 🧿️semio uses standard dir 🔖️v1 while 58 plugin artifacts use 🔖️1. Left as-is because format standards legitimately carry real version names (🔖️rfc8259, 🔖️ecma-376, 🔖️1.7), making semio's semantic standard a different class, and because it is a large mechanical change to the exact path the request quoted. Flagged rather than changed silently. ✒️writer, 🎥️shooting and 📋️forms were left alone as already-nouns.
